Why Ceiling Track Systems for Schools

attrs.values:
• Improve Safety: Enhance student and staff safety during transfers and rehabilitation activities with secure overhead support.
  • Save Floor Space: Maximize classroom space by moving mobility solutions overhead, freeing up valuable floor area for other activities.
  • Consistent Protocols: Enable consistent transfer protocols across classrooms, therapy rooms, and locker rooms.
  • Meet Standards: Meet regulatory and safety standards with professional installation and documentation.

attrs.content: Our team holds industry-leading certifications in accessibility, home modification, and assistive technology—ensuring safe, compliant installations for your school.

attrs.values:

  • Certified Aging-in-Place Specialist (CAPS): Expertise in designing spaces that serve users of all ages and abilities safely and effectively.
